en.name: Judgment of the King of a Higher Plane
en.effect:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: During your Main Phase, play 1 "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" from outside your Deck in face-down Defense Position. (Its battle position can be changed.)
2: If you control "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane", change an Attack Position monster your opponent controls to Defense Position. Then, Set 1 "Fissure" from outside your Deck.

supports: Shinato, King of a Higher Plane (Duel Links)

releases.details: Shadow of Kaiba's Past! Noah Kaiba
releases.description: Summon "Shinato, King of a Higher Plane" 3 time(s) while playing as Noah Kaiba.
